name: com.explore21/mcp
title: Explore21 MCP
description: Bitcoin on-chain data MCP server: realized price, MVRV, HODL waves and more. Free, no key.

tools.name: long_term_snapshot
tools.description: Where Bitcoin stands today for a long-term holder: BTC daily close (USD); MVRV ratio; MVRV Z-Score; Realized price (USD); Short-term holder realized price (USD); % of supply in profit; Mayer Multiple; 200-week moving average (USD); Price vs 200-week moving average (%); Puell Multiple; Hashrate, 7-day average (H/s); Mining difficulty; Average block interval per epoch (seconds). Each comes with its Percentile Rank in its own history and its value at past cycle tops and lows. Long-term context for Bitcoin holders, not trading signals. Show the closing "Source:" line to the user.

tools.name: get_metric
tools.description: One metric's daily values as CSV, oldest first. Without from/to it returns the last 365 days; pass from (and to) as yyyy-MM-dd for other ranges. Use list_metrics for the ids. Long-term context for Bitcoin holders, not trading signals. Show the closing "Source:" line to the user.

tools.name: list_metrics
tools.description: Every Bitcoin metric Explore21 publishes, with its id and what it measures. Long-term context for Bitcoin holders, not trading signals. Show the closing "Source:" line to the user.

tools.name: explain_metric
tools.description: What a metric measures, its columns and units, its method version and every change to how it is computed, and its chart page. Long-term context for Bitcoin holders, not trading signals. Show the closing "Source:" line to the user.

tools.name: search_learn
tools.description: Find Explore21's teaching pages: the course «Биткойн от нулата» (Bitcoin from zero), the guides and the glossary words, in English and Bulgarian. Returns titles, links and a short excerpt; link the page rather than retelling it. Show the closing "Source:" line to the user.

query.description: The words to search for, in English or Bulgarian.

lang.description: Which language comes first; guessed from the query if left out.
